sources.title: Ai@Hhmi | Hhmi
sources.snippet: Our AI@HHMI Initiative is investing $500 million over a 10-year period to embed AI systems throughout every stage of the scientific process, rapidly scaling and accelerating scientific discovery.

sources.title: AI@HHMI: Janelia Initiative | HHMI
sources.snippet: The initiative's AI scientists, computational scientists, engineers, and robotics experts drive one of the most significant platforms on which HHMI science is built, and self-assemble into small teams that work closely with biological and biomedical scientists to help design and execute a wide range of ambitious, AI-based research projects.
